name: NanoTrasen
text: 4lwayz has gone to sleep so I'm taking over site edits for tonight. **30 FPS HAS BEEN REACHED! (in cutscenes)** Codec (member of CGBJ) has made major leaps and bounds in system memory optimizations and the game is reaching serious levels of performance. Framerate is very smooth during gameplay. More updates to follow as I get settled in. Shout out to Mandy from Nebraska 😘
